summary: Fixed two executor state bugs in src/goal/agent-executor.ts: (1) fatal global block now marks all pending steps blocked regardless of dependency readiness, preventing zombie pending steps; (2) final build gate failure no longer mutates any done step to blocked, and instead sets session-level failure state via final gate prompt/blocked outcome with session.lastError. Added regression tests in src/goal/agent-executor.test.ts for both scenarios: all pending steps blocked on fatal error (including transitive deps) and final gate failure preserving done step status. Verification ran successfully: pnpm vitest run src/goal/agent-executor.test.ts, pnpm build, pnpm lint, and node scripts/run-node.mjs goal list.
